title: Bounded complexes with perfect cohomology
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K\in D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose that $H^i(K)=0$ outside a finite interval of integers and that, for every integer $i$, the module $H^i(K)$ in degree zero is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], that is, it admits a bounded resolution by finitely generated projective $A$-modules. Then $K$ is perfect: it is isomorphic in $D(A)$ to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $A$-modules.
